name: afk
description: AFK — AI Flow Kit. A self-contained local workflow engine that routes tasks through requirement, design, implementation, verification and delivery, with AI self-test and self-fix loops. Away From Keyboard.

interface.shortDescription: Self-contained AI workflow kit: stage routing, custom steps, auto-verify loop, dev execution with self review.
interface.longDescription: AFK routes any coding task through five universal stages: requirement, design, implementation, verification and delivery. It keeps per-project local state, lets users register custom workflow steps, and closes the loop with automated verification and feedback resolution. Everything runs locally with zero external dependencies and zero gatekeeping.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use afk-flow to route this task through requirement, design, implementation, verification and delivery.
